## DPStyleARWebLive.capture() method

Capture the StyleAR virtual try-on results as an image. If no parameters are provided, the entire area will be captured.

**Signature:**

```typescript
capture(x?: number, y?: number, width?: number, height?: number): Promise<string | undefined>;
```

**Returns:**

Promise&lt;string \| undefined&gt;

The base64 string of the captured image. Returns undefined if there is an error with the parameters or if a capture is already in progress.
